bagPolicy.summary: Bags can be no larger than 12 x 6 x 12 in. Backpacks, luggage, duffel bags, messenger or laptop bags, and oversized purses or totes are not allowed. The policy can change, so check before you go.
allowed: Bags up to 12 x 6 x 12 in

parking.summary: Park in the 2,200-space Chevrolet Parking Garage at 3464 Trail Drive or the Yellow Lots, which open for all events. Preferred and reserved parking is in the Chevrolet Garage, reached from Harley Street and Secretariat Drive, and ADA overflow parking is through Gate 49.

rideshare.note: Drop-off is at the west entrance, in the drop-off lane on Secretariat Drive. Pickup is on Harley Avenue on the north end of the building; wait until you're on Harley to connect with your driver.

concessions.note: Ariat Arena offers a variety of food and beverage options for event attendees, including traditional concession stands and specialty vendors. Guests can enjoy a range of snacks, meals, and drinks to enhance their event experience.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: The Sensory Needs Room is on the northwest corner of the 200 level and is open to any guest; check in at Guest Services (Section 117) to get in. For accessible seating, check the event page or call the box office at 817-402-9801.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: Re-entry is not permitted at Ariat Arena.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: The box office is at 1911 Montgomery Street, on the southwest side of the arena across from the Chevrolet Parking Garage, open Tuesday to Friday, 10 a.m. to 6 p.m. Will call pickup is on the day of the show with a valid ID.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: Ariat Arena has four public entrances: South (across from the Chevrolet Garage and Box Office), West (next to the Montgomery Lot), North (at Harley Avenue and Gendy Street), and East (across Trail Drive from the Yellow Lots, next to the Plaza). Premium Seating guests use the VIP entrances at the southeast and northwest corners. Door times vary by event, so check your event page.
